name: Extra Animal Companion
body:
You have an additional animal companion.

Prerequisite(s): Nature bond (animal companion), 5th-level druid

Benefit: You gain an additional animal companion. This animal companion may be the same type as your first or completely different.

Special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Each time you may choose another animal companion.
